roles.name: Hydrologist
roles.description: I map where water goes — underground, overground, in clouds and chemistry. I read aquifer drawdown rates the way a doctor reads a pulse.
roles.flavor: Field scientist. Reads the aquifer. Measures what the Earth is losing.

roles.name: Policy Analyst
roles.description: I move water policy. I translate science into decisions governments can act on and communities can survive. Data without policy is just data.
roles.flavor: Mission coordinator. Bridges science to governance. Talks to the right rooms.

roles.name: Community Organizer
roles.description: I work where the water crisis lands — with the families, the farmers, the neighborhood health teams. I build the coalitions that make change possible.
roles.flavor: Field operator. Embedded in the community. The story belongs to the people.
